package.name: Haptic Feedback
package.description: Analyzes narrative content and controls connected intimate toys in real time. Requires Intiface Central running locally — connect your toy there first, then enable this agent. Add as both a Command and an Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Commands/Misc Agents for Conversation and Roleplay modes.
